verses.text: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

xrefs.text: Of David. I give You thanks with all my heart; before the gods I sing Your praises.
Hallelujah! Sing to the LORD a new song— His praise in the assembly of the godly.
Hallelujah! Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
With my mouth I will thank the LORD profusely; I will praise Him in the presence of many.
Then I will give You thanks in the great assembly; I will praise You among many people.

verses.text: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.

xrefs.text: How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.
Know therefore that wisdom is sweet to your soul. If you find it, there is a future for you, and your hope will never be cut off.
I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.
I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Your works; I consider the work of Your hands.
and the surpassing greatness of His power to us who believe. These are in accordance with the working of His mighty strength,

verses.text: Splendid and majestic is His work; His righteousness endures forever.

xrefs.text: One generation will commend Your works to the next, and will proclaim Your mighty acts—
All You have made will give You thanks, O LORD, and Your saints will bless You.
In a loud voice they were saying: “Worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing!
His purpose was that now, through the church, the manifold wisdom of God should be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms,
Your righteousness is everlasting and Your law is true.

verses.text: He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.

xrefs.text: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.

I will make known the LORD’s loving devotion and His praiseworthy acts, because of all that the LORD has done for us— the many good things for the house of Israel according to His great compassion and loving devotion.
The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion.
For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.
to the praise of His glorious grace, which He has freely given us in the Beloved One.

verses.text: He provides food for those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.

xrefs.text: He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—
to show mercy to our fathers and to remember His holy covenant,
I will not violate My covenant or alter the utterance of My lips.
And I prayed to the LORD my God and confessed, “O, Lord, the great and awesome God, who keeps His covenant of loving devotion to those who love Him and keep His commandments,
And He remembered His covenant with them, and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion.

verses.text: He has shown His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations.

xrefs.text: Ask Me, and I will make the nations Your inheritance, the ends of the earth Your possession.
You uprooted a vine from Egypt; You drove out the nations and transplanted it.

So the sun stood still and the moon stopped until the nation took vengeance upon its enemies. Is this not written in the Book of Jashar? “So the sun stopped in the middle of the sky and delayed going down about a full day.”
With Your hand You drove out the nations and planted our fathers there; You crushed the peoples and cast them out.
So when the people broke camp to cross the Jordan, the priests carried the ark of the covenant ahead of them.

verses.text: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.

xrefs.text: The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy, making wise the simple.
Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before You.
He is the Rock, His work is perfect; all His ways are just. A God of faithfulness without injustice, righteous and upright is He.
The entirety of Your word is truth, and all Your righteous judgments endure forever.
He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—

verses.text: They are upheld forever and ever, enacted in truth and uprightness.

xrefs.text: For I tell you truly, until heaven and earth pass away, not a single jot, not a stroke of a pen, will disappear from the Law until everything is accomplished.
The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever; the judgments of the LORD are true, being altogether righteous.
The grass withers and the flowers fall, but the word of our God stands forever.”
So then, the law is holy, and the commandment is holy, righteous, and good.
and they sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb: “Great and wonderful are Your works, O Lord God Almighty! Just and true are Your ways, O King of the nations!

verses.text: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.

xrefs.text: Let them praise Your great and awesome name— He is holy!
For the Mighty One has done great things for me. Holy is His name.
He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, zealous for good deeds.
“Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, because He has visited and redeemed His people.

And they sang a new song: “Worthy are You to take the scroll and open its seals, because You were slain, and by Your blood You purchased for God those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation.

verses.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding. His praise endures forever!

xrefs.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
And He said to man, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom, and to turn away from evil is understanding.’”
When all has been heard, the conclusion of the matter is this: Fear God and keep His commandments, because this is the whole duty of man.

Observe them carefully, for this will show your wisdom and understanding in the sight of the peoples, who will hear of all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”
